one_liner: Discord offers a bot‑token and OAuth2 API for AI agents.
gating_notes: Free bot tokens are available after creating an app; OAuth2 requires user consent and scopes.
oauth_details: Use bot token for bot accounts or OAuth2 bearer token for user accounts; basic auth is for client credentials grant.
